title: NormViz: A Benchmark and Framework for Grounding Multimodal Reasoning in Global Cultures
abstract: arXiv:2609.06831v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI systems are used worldwide, but they struggle to serve the needs of culturally diverse populations. Prior work on cultural understanding evaluates AI systems on text-only settings or on visual artifact recognition (e.g. foods, clothing). The ability to reason about visually observable behaviors through local social norms, which we call visual norm understanding, remains unexamined. We introduce NormViz-Bench, a high quality, human-validated benchmark of 3,268 contrastive image pairs (6,536 images) spanning 16 countries. Each pair varies only in the culturally relevant behavior (e.g., objects, attributes, spatial relations, and actions) that alters how each image is interpreted. Each image is labeled as conforming to, violating, or irrelevant to local social norms, and pair-level evaluation requires both images to be correctly classified, thereby preventing reliance on superficial visual shortcuts. Even the strongest VLMs, Gemini 3.0 F

translated_title: NormViz：将多模态推理扎根于全球文化的基准与框架
translated_abstract: AI 系统在全球范围内被广泛使用，但它们难以满足文化多样化人群的需求。以往关于文化理解的研究仅在纯文本设置或视觉物品识别（如食物、服饰）方面评估 AI 系统。通过当地社会规范对视觉可观察行为进行推理的能力——我们称之为视觉规范理解——至今仍未被研究。我们提出了 NormViz-Bench，这是一个高质量、经过人工验证的基准，包含 3,268 组对比图像对（共 6,536 张图像），覆盖 16 个国家。每组图像对仅在文化相关行为（如物体、属性、空间关系和动作）上存在差异，而这些差异会改变对图像的解释方式。每张图像被标注为符合、违反或与当地社会规范无关，且图像对级别的评估要求两张图像均被正确分类，从而防止模型依赖表面化的视觉捷径。即使是最强大的视觉语言模型，Gemini 3.0 F
tldr: 本文提出 NormViz-Bench——一个覆盖 16 个国家、包含 3,268 组对比图像对的基准，用于评估 AI 模型通过当地社会规范理解视觉行为的能力，并发现即使是最强的视觉语言模型在此任务上也表现不佳。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces NormViz-Bench, a human-validated benchmark of 3,268 contrastive image pairs spanning 16 countries that evaluates AI systems' ability to reason about visually observable behaviors through local social norms, showing that even the strongest VLMs struggle with this task.
